author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
rationale: The memory is written and read in clk_a only, so CDC-035 (relation not Same) does not trigger. All requests are registered in clk_a, the reset is synchronous and contracted, and the output is Same.

author_reading.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
author_reading.rationale: Single-clock (clk_a) 1R1W synchronous memory in its own module, written and read only on posedge clk_a with a reset read register and complete I/O delays: no cross-clock memory.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: The request pipeline, memory writer, and registered reader share one clock. Their reset and data timing follow the same clock, so there is no cross-clock memory transfer.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: The request stage u_req and unpacked 16x8 memory u_ram (sram_1r1w) are both clocked by the same clock clk_a with synchronous reset rst_ni and complete boundary constraints, so no cross-clock memory crossing exists.
